title: introduce-devloop-workbench-devcontainer-and-cli-playground-for-local-rag-debugging
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: onboarding developers to RAG agent development requires a reproducible local workspace that mirrors production tool-calling and retrieval flows. This PR adds the 'DevLoop Workbench' — a VSCode devcontainer + lightweight CLI playground that lets engineers iterate on prompt/tool wiring, simulate vector stores, and run a local tunnel for instrumented tool endpoints without needing cloud infra. Key changes: 1) docs/rag/devloop-workbench.md — new quickstart documenting the workflow, architecture diagram links, recommended prompts, and debugging checklist; 2) examples/rag-workbench/ — a minimal repo with a sample memory-backed retriever, sample index (jsonl), two tool adapters (local-http and mock-sql), and sample prompt templates; 3) examples/rag-workbench/cli/tunnel.py — small tunneled proxy to expose a local tool to the container in a secure ephemeral way (token-based); 4) .devcontainer/ — devcontainer.json and Dockerfile pre-installed with Redwood CLI dev image and local python env; 5) site/_data/nav.yml updated to add the Workbench quickstart to the Getting Started sidebar; 6) small doc tweak to docs/style to add a 'Local testing' subsection. The description below contains a short checklist used during implementation and review: - [x] add quickstart doc with step-by-step commands and expected output - [x] provide example retriever and index for deterministic tests - [x] add secure tunnel prototype with token auth and TTL - [x] include devcontainer and prebuilt image reference - [x] validate docs build and link-check CI - [x] include security note about not using the tunnel for PII in examples Usage summary (from quickstart): clone repo, cd examples/rag-workbench, run python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt, populate sample index with scripts/setup_sample_index.py, start the tunnel: python cli/tunnel.py --port 8081 --token-file .tunnel_token, open VSCode in the devcontainer or run the sample agent: python src/agent_run.py --retriever sample-index.jsonl --tool-endpoint http://localhost:8081/tool, observe logs and structured tool-call json. Security and compliance notes: this playground is explicitly intended for local development; the tunnel uses short-lived tokens and logs are redacted by default in examples — the quickstart calls out explicit steps to scrub sensitive data before sharing. Testing: unit tests for the example retriever and linting were added to examples/tests; CI initially showed a broken internal doc link which was fixed in the same branch and CI re-ran. Related: ties to ENG-4832 (dev onboarding) and SUP-712 (support reproduction workflow). Merge rationale: developer UX win to reduce time-to-first-debug and create a canonical local test harness for RAG agent regressions.
